Active version of the core claim: It is now understood that decades of deferred maintenance actually caused the collapse, long blamed on poor design.
quests.nativeTip: Multiple clauses appear here. Focus on the core claim: was actually caused by decades of deferred maintenance.
quests.visualAnchor: 🔄 Active: It is now understood that decades of deferred maintenance actually caused the collapse, long blamed on poor design. ⇄ Passive: It is now understood that the collapse, long blamed on poor design, was actually caused by decades of deferred maintenance.
